plan.name: Check microwave and sink first for a clean egg
plan.strategy: Directly inspect the microwave and sink first to identify if the egg is already present or needs cleaning.
steps: Check the microwave first to see if a clean egg is already inside.
If no clean egg is found in the microwave, check the sink basin to see if an egg is present and needs cleaning.
If an egg is found in the sink, clean it using the sink basin.
If no egg is found in the sink or microwave, proceed to search cabinets and fridge.
